findings.title: Unconditional success return
findings.description: Function returns a success value unconditionally. If this is a reward component, it never penalizes incorrect behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Add conditional logic that actually validates the agent's output before returning a success value.

findings.title: Pairwise comparison - check position bias
findings.description: Pairwise comparison detected. Ensure position debiasing is applied (swap A/B and average, or use multiple orderings).
findings.suggested_fix: Apply position debiasing: evaluate both orderings (A,B and B,A) and average the scores. Flag inconsistent rankings.
